ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity pixels (dark grey/black) constitute approximately 92% of the visible surface area; high-intensity pixels (white) constitute approximately 8%, localized in points and streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The surface consists of a continuous field of low-intensity pigment. High-intensity pixels are distributed as discrete, circular focal points (2-10 pixel diameter) primarily concentrated along the trailing edges and distal tips, with linear streaks in the medial regions. No macro-scale contiguous mottling or banding is observed.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central notch is visible as a wide V-shaped depression; pixel-calculated interior angle is approximately 130 degrees with a shallow vertical depth relative to the adjacent lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge is characterized by high-amplitude, irregular indentations and jagged peaks (depths of 10-20 pixels). The right lobe trailing edge exhibits a more uniform, lower-amplitude (2-5 pixel) serrated pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The right lobe follows a convex upward sweep ending in a pointed distal tip. The left lobe exhibits an abrupt, near-vertical linear termination at the distal end, deviating from a standard convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity pixel clusters forming circular patterns are densely concentrated on the blunted distal edge of the left lobe and the extreme tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct light-colored linear pixel disruptions are present. A series of parallel diagonal streaks (rake marks) is visible on the mid-lateral section of the left lobe. Isolated horizontal scratches are distributed across the central medial region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant structural truncation/amputation of the distal portion of the left fluke lobe, resulting in a squared-off profile. Deep, non-uniform excisions and tissue loss are evident along the trailing edge boundary of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of the truncated left lobe distal edge and the high-density cluster of circular white anomalies on that vertical boundary is a unique visual marker.
